quest.title: The Lost Relic
quest.description: Bao'er claims to have lost a precious relic and is now frantically searching high and low for it. Perhaps she could use a hand...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I can't find it anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you lose this time...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Oh, this time I haven't lost anything yet — I'm still looking for it! But I can't find it anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Where could it be? After all the effort I've gone to to confirm its whereabouts...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Help me search for it, would you? We can't let something like this stay lost!

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Okay, you take that side, I'll take this side.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: We have to find it!

choices.text: What kind of relic is it this time?

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: It's... uh, it's an... It's really ancient, anyway! Dates back a thousand— no, all the way back to the Archon War, in fact.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Basically, it's a very precious relic and it simply cannot stay lost! So help me find it.

talks.objective: Search for the item Bao'er lost

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I can't find it anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of relic is it this time?

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: It's... uh, it's an... It's really ancient, anyway! Dates back a thousand— no, all the way back to the Archon War, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Basically, it's a very precious relic and it simply cannot stay lost! So help me find it.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler! That was terrifying... the Treasure Hoarders are such savages these days.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: I'm Soraya, a visiting scholar. I'm actually doing some research as we speak.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: A few days ago I followed a trail of clues to a ruin, where I found a jade plate that recorded details from the Archon War.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: But I was ambushed by the Treasure Hoarders on my way out. I tried to run away, but they caught up with me...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: If not for you, both I and the jade plate would have been in big trouble. So thanks again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're a scholar, too?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: ...You mean, you've met other scholars around here? Like who?

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Bao'er...? Wait a second... Just now, when I was ambushed by the Treasure Hoarders, I heard someone complaining about Bao'er hogging all the treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: What a strange coincidence... Could you tell me a little more about the Bao'er you met?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's what I remember...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: ...Hmm. The locations Bao'er pointed out to you are the same ones I was targeting. Maybe this coincidence is not so coincidental after all...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: If she really is with the Treasure Hoarders, then I suspect they must have been following me around for some time... Hoping to get at some fresh ruin treasure via me.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Bao'er wanted it all for herself, so she split off from the group and tried to get ahead. But this area is much too big for one person to search, so...

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: It seems like she used you, Traveler. And I'll bet that she had her eyes set on this location for a long time — it's just her comrades and I got there before you did.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Don't be alarmed, this is still just guesswork. But Bao'er... it's just a suspicious-sounding name. It could just be a fake name, or maybe a codename.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you throw her off the scent? Whatever happens, this jade plate cannot get into the wrong hands.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Thank you. Although, she'd probably sense something was up if you went back empty-handed.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: How about this — here's a little something you can give her instead.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Barely enough for her to make a profit on. But hopefully enough to avoid her suspicion for now.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Okay, you'd best get back. You may have just beaten the living daylights out of her comrades, but if she's traveling alone she shouldn't get word of it right away.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Oh, and if you find something on any of her future treasure hunts, you can bring it to me. I'm usually at the Wangshu Inn.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: *sigh* ...I might not be good for a lot of things, but if I can keep a historical relic safe then at least that's something.

choices.text: If I return empty-handed, she'll get suspicious...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Good point... In that case, take this. It's nothing of anything value, really.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Barely enough for her to make a profit on. But hopefully enough to avoid her suspicion for now.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: 05 Bao'er Conversation (For Bao'er)

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: What took you so long? Did you find anything?

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Huh... It's not bad, but... It doesn't look anything like the one I was looking for.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Still, a relic is a relic, so I'll take care of it. Don't worry, I'll see it gets put to good use.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Thanks for your help. In return, take these.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: *sigh* But that other lost relic, I hope it's okay...

choices.text: Is this what you were looking for?

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: It's a nice item, but not the one I was looking for.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Wait, you don't know how to take proper care of relics, do you? You might damage it.

response.speaker: Bao'er
response.text: Best if I take care of it. I'll make sure it's put to good use.

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: 05 Soraya's Idle Talk Test (For Bao'er)

dialogues.speaker: Soraya
dialogues.text: Fortunately, the jade plate is undamaged.

choices.text: Why didn't you just give it to them?

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: A relic should be for scholars to study, for artists to take inspiration from, for people to admire in an exhibition...

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: It must never be given to thieves to sell for petty cash. As well as dishonoring a precious relic, it's trampling all over history.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: I refuse to back down before people who treat history, and its relics, like trash.

choices.text: I want to know more about the jade plate.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Oh, it's piqued your interest, has it? Well answer me this — are you interested in its cultural value, or its monetary value?

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: I'm joking. This jade plate records an event from the Archon War — a clash of clans, if I'm not mistaken.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: If I can decipher it, maybe I can fill in some of the gaps in Sumeru Akademiya's records.

response.speaker: Soraya
response.text: Or maybe those gaps have been filled in already, I'm just not allowed to know about them...
